metas.description: For over fifty years, the disappearance of Paul McCartney’s original Höfner bass has been one of rock ‘n’ roll’s enduring mysteries. The Hunt for the Lost Bass tells the extraordinary story of this iconic instrument, and the fan powered quest to find it.

metas.name: The Sheriff
metas.description: A local sheriff investigates a recent murder, uncovering disturbing connections to his son's unsolved death five years earlier.

metas.name: The Sheriffs of Savage Wells
metas.description: The eccentric town of Savage Wells is looking for a sheriff. Paisley Bell has done the job before and is ready to prove she can do it again. Cade O’Brien, the most famous sheriff in Wyoming Territory, arrives in town, vying for the job as well. Sparks fly as the sheriffs go head-to-head, and the bantering rivals begin to feel like something more than just competitors. But when violent criminals threaten the people they care about, they’ll have to set aside their differences to save the town.

metas.name: Aaron Chen: Funny Garden
metas.description: Aussie comic Aaron Chen riffs on the absurdities of life in the U.S., from New York City sidewalk riddles to unexpected news sources, with deadpan wit.

metas.name: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
metas.description: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.

metas.name: Idiotka
metas.description: In West Hollywood’s Russian district, Margarita lives out the American Dream: competing on a reality show. Will she slay, serve, or survive?

metas.name: Henry David Thoreau
metas.description: Henry David Thoreau helped define modern environmentalism and nonviolent resistance, yet his life has been obscured by myth. The author of Walden and Civil Disobedience, he was brilliant but flawed, idealistic but opinionated. A writer, scientist and activist, his words resonate urgently with today’s challenges as humanity looks for ways to live in harmony with nature—and each other.

metas.name: Robot Girls
metas.description: When a robot girl companion fails to listen to its developer, the developer uses an advanced model to train the robot girl. But when the training turns deadly, the developer finds himself in trouble.

metas.name: Rory McIlroy: The Masters Wait
metas.description: Through years of heartbreak and resilience, Rory McIlroy's pursuit of the Green Jacket at the Masters becomes a reckoning with legacy and the final step toward completing golf's rarest achievement, the career Grand Slam.

metas.name: Chernobyl: 48 Hours To Escape
metas.description: Witnesses, survivors and front-line heroes recall the first days of the Chernobyl disaster of April 1986. Featuring rare archive footage of the world's worst ever nuclear accident.

metas.name: A Royal Setting
metas.description: Ruby, a world-renowned gemologist, is hired by Prince Luca to restore the crown jewels and design his crown, challenging tradition and complicating his relationship with his mother, the queen.

metas.name: Refuge
metas.description: Four estranged friends reunite on a fishing trip, but a missing child and a desperate father's accusation turn reunion into a deadly reckoning

metas.name: Color Theories by Julio Torres. A Guide to Seeing the World
metas.description: Julio Torres takes the stage in NYC and invites the audience to see the people, places, and things around us through his kaleidoscopic lens. Blending stand-up, an interactive set, and live drawings, Julio explores the inherent traits, personalities, and emotions of particular colors.

metas.name: She Dances
metas.description: A father and his distant teenage daughter road-trip to a dance competition, confronting their shared grief over a family tragedy.

metas.name: Empire of Lies
metas.description: When a mysterious young woman comes to interview a paranoid man living in rural isolation, he is forced to confront his part in his daughter's murder.

metas.name: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
metas.description: Two gangsters and the woman they love try to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine.

metas.name: Wardriver
metas.description: He’s a Wardriver: a hacker who steals from banks, not people—until he’s noticed. Now the money turns violent, and the woman caught in it could save him or kill them both.

metas.name: Holy Days
metas.description: When young Brian discovers plans to close a convent of delightfully eccentric nuns, he sets off with them on a wild road trip across New Zealand to save their home.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: When Lucky moves from India to Scandinavia on a student visa, it's a lifelong dream come true. But in Copenhagen Lucky's dream collides with a harsh reality in which people line up to take advantage of his situation, while he has to work day and night to keep his visa. What started out as a golden opportunity increasingly feels like a trap, as Lucky begins to fathom the ramifications of going abroad.

metas.name: Billy Idol Should Be Dead
metas.description: Punk legend turned pop sensation Billy Idol bares it all in this electrifying documentary, revealing his rise to fame, battle with addiction and triumphant comeback that captivated millions of fans worldwide.

metas.name: Power: The Downfall of Huw Edwards
metas.description: Docudrama following the downfall of BBC Presenter Huw Edwards.

metas.name: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
metas.description: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

metas.name: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
metas.description: Filmed in front of a live studio audience and hosted by Alex Cooper of 'Call Her Daddy' fame, Miley Cyrus reflects on the creation and impact of the series with never-before-seen archival footage, all the while interacting and reminiscing on some of the show's most memorable sets 'brought back to life' — including the Stewart family living room and the legendary Hannah Montana closet.

metas.name: Past Life
metas.description: When an unemployed reporter is hypnotized as part of a past life regression event, he wakes not with memories of life as royalty or some other glamorous person, but instead finds himself haunted by the memories of a serial killer.

metas.name: Youngblood
metas.description: Hockey prodigy Dean Youngblood joins the Hamilton Mustangs and has to deal with toxic behavior during his journey to the National Hockey League draft.

metas.name: I Killed Him in My Sleep
metas.description: Millennial Kelty Crawford struggles with financial strain, career uncertainty, and a wedding she can't afford. Desperate for money, Crawford enrolls in a sleep-study experiment that spirals into terror when she experiences a vivid, violent dream of a dying man, a bloody knife in her hand, and a voice accusing her of murder.

metas.name: Two for Tee
metas.description: Tee is a Chinese American pottery artist who meets new community center handyman Will. As she learns about her family's traditions through art, can she and Will save the center from closure?

metas.name: Maya & Samar
metas.description: Set in contemporary Athens, Maya and Samar tells the story of two young women from conflicting cultures whose brief yet torrid affair endangers the life of one, while propelling the other to instant online fame.

metas.name: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
metas.description: Explore the formative years of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the profound influence of original bandmate Hillel Slovak.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
metas.description: After his estranged son gets embroiled in a Nazi plot, self-exiled gangster Tommy Shelby must return to Birmingham to save his family — and his nation.

metas.name: Meal Ticket
metas.description: Follow the untold story of the 47-year old legacy of the McDonald's All American Game and the past, present and future stars that defined it.

metas.name: Pinecone
metas.description: Meet Pinecone in nineteenth century Ireland. A story is about love, overcoming fear and not judging others.

metas.name: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased
metas.description: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.

metas.name: Preschool
metas.description: Two determined fathers engage in a comical battle to enroll their kids in an elite preschool, escalating into an absurd competition with unexpected results.

metas.name: Inside the Rage Machine
metas.description: New whistleblowers and insiders from social media companies speak out to reveal how algorithms designed to connect people have been helping to tear them apart. With new testimony and documents, they expose a machine thriving on outrage and division as part of a business model, with radicalisation, real-world violence and fractured societies some of the consequences of a system built to shape how users think, feel and see the world.

metas.name: The Plastic Detox
metas.description: This eye-opening documentary follows six couples with unexplained infertility as they lower their exposure to plastics in hopes it helps them conceive.

metas.name: AEW Revolution 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Revolution was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on March 15, 2026, at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Adam Page in a Texas Death Match for the AEW World Championship.

metas.name: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
metas.description: Nelly and Detective Michael set out to solve the  murder of a guest while at a lavish dinner.

metas.name: Maid Robot
metas.description: A robot developer is threatened by the competition when his maid robots deem to be too powerful and human.

metas.name: Mexicali
metas.description: A former special forces contractor is forced out of retirement as an avocado farmer in Mexico when local gangsters try to force him and his family off their farm.

metas.name: When We Move
metas.description: Edith, the youngest member of a family of nine, navigates moving houses for the very first time.

metas.name: The Gates
metas.description: Three friends' road trip turns terrifying when they witness a murder in a gated community. Trapped inside, hunted by residents who blame them, their bond fractures as a charismatic yet sinister patriarch closes in.

metas.name: Storm Rider: Legend of Hammerhead
metas.description: Centuries after the Great Flood, riders compete in death races on the water to secure shelter for their people behind the walls of Argos. Rebellious storm riders Neb and Ana look to uncover hidden truths by breaking through the storm.

metas.name: Sugar & Vice: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
metas.description: Hannah finds a body at the grand re-opening of the Lake Eden Inn. When a storm traps everyone inside, Hannah must find the culprit before the road clears and the killer escapes.

metas.name: Kill Me
metas.description: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub after having tried to kill himself. Or, at least, that’s what it looks like to his friends and family. Jimmy is pretty sure he didn’t do it… maybe. Together with Margot, the 911 operator who took his call, Jimmy sets out on a mission to solve a vitally important whodunit: did someone try to kill him, or are they chasing the spectre of depression?

metas.name: Destination North
metas.description: In 2056, there has been a zombie outbreak caused by the polluted and contaminated water all over the world. In this story we are in Scotland, following the journey of two sisters trying to survive and adapt in this new way of the world. They believe if they go further North it will be easier to survive there. On their travels they come across love and loss, meeting and joining an orphan group. They continue their path North together, but there's more than that to the story...  Watch and find out, and be hyped for this is only the beginning of their story.

metas.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
metas.description: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.

metas.name: Derrick Stroup: Nostalgic
metas.description: Stroup dives into his experience being a '90s kid in rural Alabama and everything that came along with it.

metas.name: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
metas.description: The definitive account of Japan’s struggle as it faced a nuclear catastrophe while still reeling from the devastation of an earthquake and tsunami.

metas.name: Midwinter Break
metas.description: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

metas.name: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester.
metas.description: In a special one off concert in Manchester, recorded on the evening of March 6, Harry Styles played his new album, ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.' for the very first time.

metas.name: Ghost Elephants
metas.description: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory.

metas.name: NXT Vengeance Day 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Vengeance Day was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE for its NXT brand, held on March 7, 2026, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, and was headlined by Joe Hendry (c) vs. Ricky Saints for the NXT Championship.

metas.name: The Last Hail Mary
metas.description: When the planet Mercury is swallowed up by the Sun’s gravitational pull, a team aboard the Interplanetary Space Station, including a suspicious Martian scientist, must race to reverse the effect before Venus, and even Earth, are destroyed forever.

metas.name: Mother's Pride
metas.description: A comedy about a failing pub, a divided community and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

metas.name: Good Boy
metas.description: Tommy, a volatile 19-year-old, revels in drugs, parties and violence. After getting separated from his friends on a drunken bender, he is abducted by a shadowy figure. He wakes to find himself imprisoned in the basement of a remote Yorkshire house, inhabited by a very strange family. But what unfolds is not what he could possibly expect.

metas.name: Othello
metas.description: Moorish general Othello is manipulated into thinking that his new wife Desdemona has been carrying on an affair with his lieutenant Michael Cassio when in reality it's all part of a scheme orchestrated by bitter ensign Iago. Filmed live at the Theatre Royal Haymarket in London especially for the big screen.

metas.name: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
metas.description: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

metas.name: When We Get There
metas.description: Brothers Cal and Ty, embark on a cross-country trek to meet the father they’ve never known, and the only family they have left. Along with Cal’s long-term girlfriend Ellie and a new guitar named Stevie, the trio are forced to navigate uncertain futures on a 2000-mile journey in a car on its last leg. Along the way they discover what, and who, it’s worth showing up for.

metas.name: Diabolical - The Epstein Files
metas.description: It's the scandal that has shocked Americans and rocked the Trump administration. A legal and political saga that has shattered fundamental beliefs that all are equal in the eyes of the law. What do the Epstein Files reveal?

metas.name: Martin Luther King Jr.: Enemies of the Dream
metas.description: The fight for racial equality came at a cost. Martin Luther King Jr. rose as a powerful voice for justice, yet was seen as a threat by some. Declassified records fuel questions about whether more lay behind the silencing of his voice.

metas.name: Murder in the Highland Manor
metas.description: Kate takes a job as a live-in tutor at a secluded Scottish estate for a mother and daughter who’ve escaped domestic abuse. But when she discovers the previous au pair mysteriously disappeared, Kate becomes embroiled in the family’s deadly secrets.

metas.name: Pushed Off a Plane and Survived
metas.description: Jaynie miraculously cheats death after her husband Cole’s betrayal.

metas.name: Romance at Hope Ranch
metas.description: Hope Morgan sets out to begin a new chapter of her life—fulfilling her childhood dream of running a ranch in the picturesque town of Ruidoso, New Mexico and reviving the beloved Giddy Up Gala.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A group of friends vacation on a lake front cabin and find Aladdin's ancient lamp which grants 3 terrible wishes.

metas.name: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
metas.description: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.

metas.name: The Napa Boys
metas.description: Jack Jr, Miles Jr and the whole gang are back for one last wine-soaked journey prompted by the mysterious "Sommelier." Joined this time by Puck, a fan of The Napa Boys comics, the group will learn about love, loss, friendship and viticulture.

metas.name: On the Hunt
metas.description: A former military woman takes on a ruthless criminal underworld in a race against time to find her missing daughter.

metas.name: For Worse
metas.description: Lauren, a newly divorced, sober mom, feels like she has a new lease on life after joining her first acting class and starting a fling with her hot, young scene partner. However, when they attend their Gen Z classmate's wedding together, things begin to fall apart, and Lauren finds herself behaving like a drunk 25-year-old bridesmaid. Luckily after a disastrous night she stumbles into a new day and a new beginning.

metas.name: Bring the Law
metas.description: A disgraced LA cop is chosen to lead a task force against a local crime syndicate and uncovers a conspiracy of corruption in his own department.

metas.name: Undercard
metas.description: After abandoning her son, a female boxing trainer rises from the ashes to coach him in the biggest fight of his career.

metas.name: Operation Taco Gary's
metas.description: Two brothers uncover an alien invasion hidden inside a fast-food chain and must save Earth.

metas.name: Starbright
metas.description: A young woman becomes the guardian of a fallen star, which she must protect from dangerous forces with the help of a brave stranger.

metas.name: Figure Skating Exhibition Gala | Milano Cortina 2026
metas.description: A star-studded line-up of figure skaters, including Olympic champions Alysa Liu, Mikhail Shaidorov, Guillaume Cizeron/Laurence Fournier Beaudry, and Miura Riku/Kihara Ryuichi deliver a spectacular show on ice to wrap up the 2026 Winter Olympics.

metas.name: Man on the Run
metas.description: Paul McCartney forms new band Wings after Beatles breakup. Archival home footage shows his life with Linda, who influenced his music. The film follows Wings from formation through the 1970s, during which McCartney wrote hit songs.

metas.name: The Bluff
metas.description: When her tranquil life on a remote island is shattered by the return of her vengeful former captain, a skilled ex-pirate must confront her bloody past and unleash her deadly talents to save her family from a ruthless siege.

metas.name: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
metas.description: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

metas.name: Pete Holmes: Silly Silly Fun Boy
metas.description: Comedian Pete Holmes delivers fresh takes on parenting, marriage and more.

metas.name: The Stars Between Us
metas.description: Seven years ago, Kim made a connection with a stranger during an eclipse event. Now a fledgling news reporter, Kim returns to Illinois for this year's eclipse, unaware that their paths may cross again.

metas.name: One Mile: Chapter Two
metas.description: Former special forces operative Danny is forced back onto a remote island when a violent, secretive community takes revenge by abducting his daughter Alex, launching a relentless hunt against enemies prepared for his every move.

metas.name: I Don't Love You Anymore
metas.description: A man is found floating lifeless in a suburban couple’s pool, and nothing about the story adds up. In separate police interrogations, their conflicting accounts twist and fracture, revealing a Rashomon-like web of deceit, buried desire, and long-denied truths. As the night of the shooting replays from shifting perspectives, a tale of love, loyalty, and betrayal slowly surfaces — darker and more disturbing than anyone wants to admit.

metas.name: Lazarus: The Awakening
metas.description: A vigilante resurrected from death hunts a drug empire in Jackson, clashing with a kingpin, a reporter, and a city consumed by fentanyl. Justice becomes war.

metas.name: One Mile: Chapter One
metas.description: After being released from special forces, a father tries to reconnect with his daughter by taking her on a tour of college, but they soon find themselves fighting for more than their lost relationship when a murderous cult pursues them.

metas.name: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane
metas.description: In this emotional interview, the late actor and ALS advocate Eric Dane shared his final message for the world — knowing it would not air until his death.

metas.name: Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide - Concert Special
metas.description: Celebrating the high-energy music from the iconic Descendants and ZOMBIES franchises, the Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide Tour thrilled sold-out crowds in over 40 arenas across North America last summer. Now, families and fans of all ages can relive the excitement - singing and dancing along with their favorite stars from the comfort of home.

metas.name: Hellfire
metas.description: A drifter with a mysterious past arrives in a small town and finds the residents in the grip of a ruthless crime boss and realizes he has to help them.

metas.name: Sommore: Chandelier Fly
metas.description: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.

metas.name: The Darkest Web
metas.description: For US agent Greg Squire and a dedicated network of specialist undercover investigators around the world, the mission is clear: track and catch serial paedophiles who operate across the dark web with the same sophistication and secrecy as international organised crime syndicates. Increasingly, these offenders are far younger than the stereotypical image of a paedophile - tech-savvy young adults who exploit digital anonymity with alarming ease.

metas.name: The Singers
metas.description: An impromptu singing contest at a dive bar turns a lonely night into a soul-baring moment of shared harmony.

metas.name: You Can't Win
metas.description: The true-crime story of legendary outlaw Jack Black, whose 1926 memoir became an unlikely bestseller upon its release and later inspired generations of counter-cultural writing.
